rationale: The agent retrieved the user and order details and submitted returns for all items on the two orders, and the final summary matches the tool actions on the correct orders. However, it violated key policy requirements: it did not ask the user to confirm before performing order-changing writes (returns were submitted immediately), and it did not attempt or explain the requested cross-refund to the opposite payment methods, nor get consent to proceed with original payment methods when that cross-refund was presumably not possible. It also did not hand off or clarify limitations. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with the policy.
